files.note: High oblique drone view from above the south-east corner into the empty bowl, April 2026, sunny morning with long shadows, Hartford skyline on the horizon. Field just left of centre (x ~740-1680) and in rows ~640-1100 of 1714 (37-64%). A 16:9 crop of rows ~300-1650 puts the field at ~25-59%; a light tower stands in the lower right, outside the field.
